## Parent

#316 (board UI spec, §7 and §11)

## What to build

A prefactor so every later slice builds on one set of rules: the board decides a lane's state, a phase's step and a lane's blockers in one place each, and the test harness can fake GitHub and Vercel separately.

parent.title: chore(ship-board): board UI — epic map, epic overview, lane page with the blocker map

issue.title: chore(ship-board): one shared rule set in lane-core and a per-tool fake connector in the harness
